name: seis-mcp-inventory
description: Inventory local MCP manifests and declared capabilities without starting servers.

interface.shortDescription: Project declared MCP servers and permission metadata.
interface.longDescription: Reads bounded local MCP and plugin manifests and summarizes declared server names, transports and tools. It never starts a server or verifies connectivity.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inventory declared MCP manifests in this local repository.
